validityStream.deleteSemantics: Skip delete predecessors and delete successors; retain V1 update redirection.

policyGrid.packing: Greedily retain validity-stream order; skip an item when adding it would exceed floor(V1 injected tokens times budgetFraction); never reorder or partially truncate content.
policyGrid.zeroBudgetBehavior: Inject no memory rather than exceed the hard budget.

optimizer.trainingSubset: weekly/monthly current-state questions with at least one obsolete atom
optimizer.quality: mean evidence-FAMA proxy delta versus V1
optimizer.harm: mean positive per-case evidence-FAMA proxy loss versus V1 on the protected subset
optimizer.cost: mean packed-token fraction of per-query V1 tokens on all weekly/monthly questions
optimizer.utility: quality - harmPenalty * harm - costPenalty * cost - fallbackPenalty * fallbackRate
optimizer.selectionTieBreak: higher quality, lower harm, lower cost, lower maxItems, lower budget fraction

evaluation.primarySubset: quarterly questions with at least one obsolete atom and task in {remembering, recommending}

fallback.invalidPolicyOrFeature: Return exact Base Top-k for the whole call.
fallback.validityTimeoutOrDamage: Return exact Base Top-k for the whole call.
fallback.packingException: Return exact Base Top-k for the whole call.

claimBoundary: Optimization and held-out direct proxies can qualify answer testing only. They cannot establish answer quality or programming-task utility.
